Summary: The Principle Software Engineer - Android is responsible for design, development, testing and support of new and existing software components for the company’s Android based Reverse Vending Machine. The Principle Software Engineer - Android is responsible for identifying, documenting and fixing defects. Will work with the Validation team to create and execute comprehensive test plans. The Engineer will also be responsible for research and documentation of new and existing functionality and technologies.
 Essential Duties & Responsibilities
Development and Implementation of Reverse Vending Machine Software for all products within the company
Developing new Features for our Android product lines.
Resolve issues related to Reverse Vending Machine database functionality.
Work with senior engineering staff to ensure architectural continuity in our development.
Mentor engineers to ensure architectural conformance.
Contribute to the definition of software requirements and functional operation of our system.
Continuous improvement of architecture, tools, and processes.
Communicate with Envipco cross-function teams to
Facilitate the generation of functional requirements and system testing.
Ensure functionality is properly validated
Provide third-tier field support.
 Qualifications & Education
Bachelor’s Degree in Software Engineering or equivalent industry experience - Within Software Engineering, Computer Science or similar.
MUST have a High proficiency in Kotlin, JAVA and C++ for Android systems
10 - 15 years of programming experience.
Deep understanding of the Android SDK, UI layouts, and design guidelines.
Experience working with RESTful APIs, JSON, and third-party libraries.
Experience using Linux as a development platform.
Experience with the design, development, and maintenance of Android software packages.
Experience with Python is a plus.
Customer focused.
Excellent communication and team working skills 
Motivated, independent, and structured way of working  
Very good language skills in English. 
 What We Offer
A high degree of freedom.
An opportunity to help building and become part of a fast-growing global company.
A varied job in an equally experienced, qualified and committed team.
Independent working method with lot of personal responsibility and freedom.
Flat hierarchies in a modern corporate structure, exposure to senior leadership.
Attractive and performance-oriented compensation.
Flexible working hours, attractive remuneration, individual development programs, access to the corporate benefits portal
Employee referral program, networking events, team workshops
25 days of well-earned annual leave right from the start
Joint company events
Ergonomic workstations
Health campaigns
 While the skills and experience outlined above are important, we know that the right candidate may not meet every requirement. If you believe you have the right values, behaviors and motivation to succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply.
We are committed to building diverse teams and creating opportunities for talented individuals to grow their careers with us.
